result.summary: Found several layout and styling issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest carousel, a misaligned delivery badge on the ramen card, and a cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards and text have enough width so names are not clipped.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' badge on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card sits awkwardly over the image edge and may collide with the food illustration.
issues.suggestion: Reposition or restyle the badge with consistent padding/margin so it sits cleanly within the image bounds.

issues.description: Category filter chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the far right, looking unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper horizontal padding or fade so partial empty chips are not shown, or clip cleanly at the last full chip.
